author: ActivityHub community
short: A safe RuneScape companion with official login handoff.
description: An ActivityHub companion interface that opens the official RuneScape site without handling credentials.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores no account credentials. The web page may store an optional player display name in the browser's local storage.
install_msg: RuneScape Companion needs the ActivityHub cog to be loaded first. It uses the official RuneScape website for authentication.
